attribution: Calculated positions · NASA/JPL Horizons; Earth orientation by our transform (code derived from ERFA)

flags.UT~: Horizons holds the last known leap second constant (future leap seconds not yet known)

time.leap_second_source: IERS Bulletin C 72 (Paris, 06 July 2026): no leap second at the end of December 2026; UTC-TAI = -37 s

transform.name: IAU 2006 bias-precession + GMST 2006 (transcribed from ERFA 1a8044c)
assumptions: Earth-centred ICRF axes of the exports taken as aligned with the GCRS input
